issues.title: 2027 PHA Annual Plan and Capital Fund Program Plan
issues.summary: CDA resolution to submit the required Public Housing Authority Annual Plan and Capital Fund Program Plan for fiscal year 2027. This plan addresses housing authority operations, capital improvements, and public housing program priorities for the coming year.

public_comment.instructions: Submit comments before CDA Board meeting on October 8, 2026

issues.why_it_matters_to_you: Public housing and affordable housing policy directly affects Madison's ability to meet the 15,000-unit housing goal with 25% affordability targets that align with progressive values on economic access and community stability.
